learn_source: Watch the newcomer-mage tug something loose from a high shelf in the Forager's Clearing — a collector's reach for what the hand can't get
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a small loose thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the pull is smooth and lands the thing in your palm; at baseline it hops and drops short, and you pick it up off the ground. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Pulls free and drops within reach
no_effect — far too heavy; it does not so much as rock
Tugs the tempered stone across and seats it into the wall's socket — the way into the Heart of the Wood opens
State-dependent: unlatched, it swings open toward the pull; latched, it rattles once and holds
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; the bird is not moved

receivers.reaction_kind: names the act plainly to the caster's face, without heat
